rachel-peopleops: Heads-up — Olga Petrova (candidate) arrives Wed 07:05, interview loop 09:30–12:30. She submitted a scent-free accommodation request and asked about early badge pickup + a loaner laptop. Can facilities confirm Quiet Room availability and badge process? tagging @facilities-bot

facilities-bot: Hi! We can reserve Quiet Room B and hold a badge at security for pickup at 07:50. Laptop loaner available (stock image with Chrome + VS Code). Please fill the visitor ops form: https://redwood.internal/forms/visitor-ops — paste candidate name, arrival ETA, and any special kit requests.

omar-recruiter: Candidate lands early (7:05am flight) and may wait on-site. Can we get an all-day parking permit for her? Also asked for a nut-free lunch. I'll confirm travel ETA in the event.

rachel-peopleops: Thanks. I've added a note to the calendar event and set the interview start to 09:30. Ordering nut-free boxed lunch. Badge pickup instructions for security:```
Name: Olga Petrova
Company: Redwood (visitor)
Code: BADGE-OLGA-2073
Pickup time: 07:50
ID required: passport or driver's license
```
Also adding a scent-free reminder to the panel invite: "Please avoid perfumes/colognes — candidate requested scent-free room."

nico-eng: I can shift my slot earlier to 10:00 instead of 10:30, that's fine by me :thumbsup:

sam-ops: Confirming Quiet Room B reserved from 07:30–13:00, desk 4 set with power + external monitor. Laptop loaner will be image RL-STD-2025, credentials will be dropped in the secured envelope at security with the badge. Parking permit QR (single-use):```
PERMIT-QR-OLGA-47X
``` Will share the morning-of scan link in #reception.

olga-p (candidate): Thank you — appreciate the accommodations and heads-up on lunch. See you Wednesday.

rachel-peopleops: Perfect, thanks everyone. Sam — can you ping here at 07:10 the morning of to confirm badge/laptop ready? I'll DM Olga the security desk number and remind her to bring ID. :white_check_mark:
